# nova-tools fixes

<!-- Generated from docs/fixes.sexp by tools/roadmap. Do not edit this file: edit docs/fixes.sexp and run `make roadmap`. -->

The point releases after v1.2.2: what each one shipped, is shipping or will ship. A point release carries fixes only; new work is in ROADMAP.md. nova-sprint's point releases are in that repository's FIXES.md.

## v1.2.3 (shipped, 2026-10-10)

The split: nova-sprint, nova-card and nova-work, with their models and docs, leave this repository for mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint.

- **The sprint tools leave nova-tools** (shipped). Their commands, packages, models and docs move to mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint, and CI refuses their paths here. From: the split, layers L5 to L7; PR #5591.

## v1.2.4 (shipped, 2026-10-10)

One fix: the sprint store's function library is back at its v1.2.2 digest, so an adopt can load it.

- **Six Lua comment lines restored** (shipped). The function library's digest is its v1.2.2 value again, so the adopt's shadow tick accepts it. From: PR #5592, head 7d1dc0c06.

## v1.2.6 (planned)

The fixes held during the split, the point-release candidates found on 2026-10-10, the owed tests, and the sprint store cards that are point-release work. Each is re-applied or written in this repository, then cut as one release.

- **ROADMAP.md and FIXES.md generated from s-expression data** (shipped). docs/roadmap.sexp and docs/fixes.sexp are the data; `make roadmap` writes both pages, and a test fails when a page differs from what its data renders. From: PR #5533.
- **A walled lane tokens are read where its harness writes them** (shipped). Walled sessions live under the wall home, tokens are read from there first, and a session in no database is unread rather than zero, so the token cap can trip. From: nova-tools PR #5590, head 0c4fd7ea; landed in dev as 1babe4a43f via PR #5595.
- **A provider that refuses its key rests until woken, never for a time** (shipped). A route whose provider refuses the key rests until routes wake, never for a time, and the rest reason reads until woken rather than until paid: the providers table, the stop and the judgment all say woken. TLA+ model RouteRest, property AuthEndsOnlyWoken, with a reversed witness. Tests cover routes wake on a key rest. From: nova-tools PR #5574, head 0c6706f2d; the providers table's until-paid wording is v1.2.5 candidate 6.
- **A bare merge --stream is refused on a real store** (shipped). Landings are recorded by name or by land; a bare merge --stream on a real store is refused. From: nova-tools PR #5565, head 52618fa02.
- **A hard pin past its bound is offered on; a rule answer is consumed by its attempt** (shipped). A hard pin past its bound is offered to others, a card cannot ask once it waits, and a rule answer is consumed by its attempt. The pin release clock comment is corrected: the hour runs from the stop's latest note, so a coordinator's ack or wait starts it again, and a test says so. From: nova-tools PR #5573, head daab75763, re-applied here.
- **A PATHS widening on a reader finding edits the card in place** (shipped). A reader finding that widens PATHS edits the card in place, never a twin. Three review notes are fixed before merge: the finding reader is unset only when the card holds it, the bound subtest reaches the attempt cap, and the friend card claim says a widen does not pin her next attempt. From: nova-tools PR #5570, head 22d72154d, re-applied here.
- **check honours a waived second read; where shows tiers once** (shipped). check judges an accept made before the second-read count by the count then; where shows a tier once and hides an expired until. A stale health seen time beside a live status is also fixed. From: nova-tools PR #5584, head 881df6ff.
- **where --json reads no log line for its landed series** (shipped). The tick counts landings into the where record, so where --json answers in well under a second (8.9 to 12.8 s before, 0.4 to 0.7 s after, measured on a copy of the live store); released sentinels are not counted as landings. The public dashboard mirror's server.py (internal/sprintdash/stopgap) is now versioned here: it stamps fetchedAt with the snapshot's own time and adds dataAgeSeconds. AFTER THE DEPLOY, in the final adopt: rebuild the dashboard's nova-sprint-int2 (~/nova-bench/dashboard/bin/nova-sprint-int2) from this release, copy internal/sprintdash/stopgap/server.py over ~/nova-bench/dashboard/server.py, and restart the public mirror unit. From: nova-tools PR #5588, head 08f6af5a8.
- **A card already done at its base is a duplicate brief, not a worker failure** (shipped). Nothing to do because the base already contains the change is a brief defect, a duplicate of landed work, outside ok%, and raises a re-cut judgment. From: nova-tools PR #5585, head 0beb0508.
- **A draining member does not keep a stale no-room word** (shipped). The room check runs after the drain return, so a draining member does not keep a stale no-room word; the deal and read disk floor fix also gets its TLA+ reversed witness. From: v1.2.5 candidate list; nova-tools PR #5569 follow-up.
- **A draining member's beat carries this tick's no-room word** (shipped). The member asks Room every tick before the drain return, so a member that drained under its disk floor stops saying no room once the disk is freed (nova-sprint tla/NoRoom.tla, WordIsThisTicks). From: v1.2.5 candidate 5; the PR #5569 follow-up.
- **A bench tree is a standalone clone, and one that is not is refused with its reason** (shipped). The mirror stage ends by checking that the staged tree's .git is a directory in the tree, and a .git file (a worktree pointer at a path of another machine) is refused naming the gitdir and whether it exists on the host. The tar copy refuses a worktree's .git file instead of carrying it over, so git no longer exits 128 on a fleet host with nothing saying why. From: lander fault 5579, fleet git exit 128 (held-PR ledger row 5579).
- **A friend's lane wall reads the pinned harness it runs** (shipped). nova-friend install takes --wall-reads and writes it into the agent, and the seat play passes nova_friend_wall_reads to a reinstall whose plist records none, so a pinned harness whose shim execs a directory under the home no longer exits 126 (Operation not permitted) for every lane. From: a one-shot friend host, 2026-10-10: every lane exit 126 after the harness pin; the wall denied reading the pinned harness directory.
